title: Evaluation of emissions and spatial distribution of methane from offshore oil and gas platforms in the Liaodong Bay of China based on shipboard measurement
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00758A, Paper
Yue Yu, Zongcai He, Qing Su, Xuemei Xu, Jiayi Cheng, Yue Ming, Xiaomeng Wang, Hong Chen, Jianbo Han
Offshore oil and gas platforms are a notable source of methane (CH4) in the marine environment, yet there remains a lack of comprehensive understanding regarding their impact along the coastal areas of China.
